description: View an interactive Git Graph of your repository and perform Git actions from the graph.
overview:
Visualize your project's commit history, branches, tags, stashes, and working-tree changes inside a dedicated project tab.

## What you get

- **Interactive Commit DAG**: Multi-lane SVG commit graph (`rounded` or `angular` curves) with local/remote branch pills, tags, stashes, `HEAD` indicator, and an Uncommitted Changes row.
- **Commit Details & Two-Commit Comparison**: Click any commit to inspect metadata, GPG signature status, and changed files in a hierarchical File Tree or flat File List, or `Ctrl/Cmd+Click` a second commit to compare any two revisions.
- **Inline Unified & Split Diff Viewer**: Inspect file diffs directly inside the Commit Details pane.
- **Persistent Code Reviews**: Start a Code Review on any commit or comparison and check off files as you review them.
- **Full Context Menus & Git Actions**: Right-click branches, tags, commits, stashes, or uncommitted changes to checkout, create/rename/delete branches, merge, rebase, cherry-pick, revert, reset, drop commits, manage tags/stashes, or open a Pull Request.
- **Ask Agent Integration**: Click **Ask Agent** on any commit or diff to spawn a Zana thread pre-populated with the commit metadata and patch context.

## For agents

Use `zcc git-graph repos|log|details|compare|diff|remotes` from the CLI or the `git_graph_inspect` agent tool.
